story_info.title: Barnaby Bunny's Starry Calm
story_info.subtitle: Finding peace under the night sky.
story_info.moral: Taking slow breaths helps us feel calm and ready for sleep.

main_character.name: Barnaby Bunny
main_character.appearance: Barnaby is a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look.

cover.prompt: Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Barnaby Bunny sitting in Moonlight Meadow at night, looking up at the bright, calm stars. Soft lighting, pastel colours, children's book illustration, vertical composition, Instagram friendly.

slides.title: A Twinkling Night
slides.text: It was evening in Moonlight Meadow. Barnaby Bunny looked up. The sky was turning dark blue. Tiny, bright stars began to pop out. They twinkled high above him. Barnaby loved the stars. They looked like little shiny diamonds.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby sees the first stars appear in the evening sky.

slides.title: A Little Bit Wiggly
slides.text: Barnaby felt a little bit wiggly inside. He had played all day long. His paws felt like dancing. But soon it would be time for sleep. How could he feel calm now? He wanted to rest his sleepy eyes.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby feels restless after playing all day.

slides.title: Remembering Mama's Words
slides.text: Barnaby sat down on the soft grass. He remembered his Mama Bunny's words. 'When you feel wiggly, look at the stars,' she would say. 'Then take a big, slow breath.' Barnaby tried to do just that. He closed his eyes gently.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby remembers his mother's advice to calm down.

slides.title: Slow and Steady Breaths
slides.text: He took a deep breath in. He counted, 'One, two, three.' Then he let the air out slowly. He did it again. 'One, two, three.' The air felt cool. He imagined his wiggles leaving with each breath. Barnaby kept breathing slowly.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby practices slow, deep breathing to relax.

slides.title: Sweet Dreams Begin
slides.text: Soon, Barnaby felt much calmer. His paws did not want to dance anymore. His eyes felt sleepy. The stars seemed to sparkle just for him. He whispered, 'Sweet dreams begin with a smile!' He snuggled into his soft bed. Barnaby was ready for sleep.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby feels calm and ready for sleep, ending his day peacefully.
